name: card
description: A content container with header, body, and footer sections for grouping related information
designIntent: Card groups related content into a scannable container. Use it for settings panels, feature highlights, user profiles, and any content that benefits from visual grouping.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element (router Link, <a>) with card styling instead of a div.

examples.title: Card as a link
examples.description: Whole card becomes a semantic link without losing styling.

examples.description: Minimal card without header or footer

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest Cards
antiPatterns.explanation: Nesting cards creates visual noise. Use dividers or spacing within a single Card.

accessibility.userRequirements: Maintain logical heading order in your page
